base: Value of the estate accounted for by the personal representative: inventory appraisal value plus gains over appraisal on sales plus receipts, less losses on sales, without reference to encumbrances (Prob. Code §§ 10800(b), 10810(b)).

schedules.text: 4% of the first $100,000, 3% of the next $100,000, 2% of the next $800,000, 1% of the next $9,000,000, 0.5% of the next $15,000,000; above $25,000,000 a reasonable amount determined by the court (Prob. Code § 10800(a)). Extraordinary services may be compensated separately (Prob. Code § 10801).
schedules.capNote: Schedule stops at $25,000,000; the excess earns a court-determined reasonable amount, not computed here.

schedules.text: Same percentages as the personal representative: 4% / 3% / 2% / 1% / 0.5% on the same brackets; above $25,000,000 a reasonable amount set by the court (Prob. Code § 10810(a)). Extraordinary services extra (Prob. Code § 10811).
